_readme: TESTIMONIALS THE BUSINESS COLLECTED ITSELF.
These are NOT Google reviews. They appear under 'Our customers, our work'
and every card is badged 'Shared with us directly'. Google's own reviews
come from the Business Profile and are shown in a separate section.
HOW TO ADD ONE
1. Copy the block in "example" below into the "testimonials" list.
2. Fill it in with the customer's ACTUAL words. Do not tidy them up,
do not translate them, do not shorten them to the flattering half.
3. Set "published" to true. Anything without it stays off the site.
4. Commit the file. The change is live as soon as it deploys.
BEFORE YOU PUBLISH ONE, YOU NEED THE CUSTOMER'S PERMISSION.
A WhatsApp message saying 'yes, you can put this on your website' is
enough, and it is worth keeping. Publishing someone's name and words
without asking is the kind of thing that only goes wrong once.
DO NOT write a testimonial for a customer, however true you believe it
to be. An invented testimonial under a real person's name is a problem
no amount of extra traffic is worth.
FIELDS
name       as the customer is happy to be named. 'Rohit S.' is fine.
text       their words, unedited.
rating     1-5, optional. Leave it out if they did not give one.
date       'YYYY-MM', optional. Shown as 'March 2026'.
area       optional, e.g. 'Swaroop Nagar to Lucknow'.
published  true to show it. Set false to take it down without deleting.
The "example" block below is ignored by the website. It is only here so
there is something to copy.
